regulatory.title: BIS for notified electrical products
regulatory.text: Check whether motor starters or your components fall under compulsory BIS certification; switchgear standards (IS/IEC 60947 series) are the usual reference.

regulatory.title: Telecom equipment certification (MTCTE)
regulatory.text: Telecom equipment sold in India needs testing and certification under MTCTE; using a pre-certified GSM module may reduce what your product needs. Confirm for your design.

regulatory.title: E-waste producer responsibility
regulatory.text: Producers of listed electrical and electronic equipment register for extended producer responsibility under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022. Check whether your product category is listed.

regulatory.title: Personal data in the phone app
regulatory.text: If the app collects farmers' phone numbers or locations, consent and security duties apply under the DPDP Act, 2023.
